LOOK: Department of Health (DOH) Sec. Ted Herbosa, together with other DOH officials, holds an inspection at the National Kidney and Transplant Institute (NKTI) and the Philippine Heart Center (PHC) on Monday, Dec. 22, to ensure the hospitals' readiness in providing emergency medical services this Yuletide season.

Herbosa said the inspection focuses on the health facilities' preparedness in responding to non-communicable diseases (NCDs) such as acute coronary syndrome, stroke, and bronchial asthma, as well as road traffic injuries and fireworks-related injuries. (Photos by Patrick Garcia)
